matches.title: Backing up the full FortiSwitch configuration to an SFTP/FTP/TFTP server
matches.role: Scenario companion only. It documents external backup transfer and is not the primary source for OpenSSL security levels.

methodology: Broad product-area searches plus topic-specific searches with an October 12-November 11, 2026 date window. Older results and recent-but-unrelated articles were not promoted as scenario evidence. Community/KB/TAC material was not used as a primary lesson source.
limitation: Eleven of twelve selected lesson mechanisms have no directly matched recent Community scenario verified in this run; the sweep was performed, but scenario coverage is incomplete.
